title: Heliotropy: the gradient is the name
note: Heliotropy is how plants turn to the sun, so a soft yellow sun glow drifts across the page behind everything. Heavy condensed caps sit next to a soft serif, people are white cards with big names, and a full William Stafford poem gets its own screen. The colophon names the typefaces (P22 Mackinac Pro, MARTIN, a "non-violent typeface") and why they were chosen. Readymag Websites of the Year 2023, storytelling winner. Worth taking: a gradient is fine when the site's idea needs it.
